3. Field rules

  • One row per respondent. No names required (confidential).
  • Use same wording every time (e.g. Always/Often/Sometimes/Rarely/Never).
  • Numbers for ratings/hours make analysis 10× easier.
  • Aim 20 minimum; 25 is safer (spoilt forms).
